audit_method.evaluator: AI-assisted manual review by Codex; student must verify before submission
audit_method.coherence_sampling: The first chunk covering character position 0 on physical PDF pages 1-10, fixed before comparing strategies.
audit_method.coherence_scale: 0=cut mid-idea or not understandable; 1=partly understandable but missing context; 2=self-contained and complete.
audit_method.grounding_sampling: All five held-out test questions q16-q20; read the complete top-3 text for each strategy.
audit_method.grounding_scale: 0=no supporting evidence; 1=some evidence but missing a necessary condition/context; 2=enough evidence to answer and trace the source.
audit_method.bias_note: The same assistant helped implement the pipeline and label the audit. Labels are transparent but not independent, so the student should re-read the cited chunks.
